declared_protocol.execution_validation: KTRF: complete raw response through production execution guard. Controls: schema and visible ID membership only.
declared_protocol.gold_source: Authored document worlds and glossary definitions, fixed across all conditions.
limitations: AI-authored synthetic full documents and annotations; not human gold or deployment risk estimates.
No-context conditions are information floors for private definitions and opaque IDs, not fair knowledge-parity baselines.
World gold stays fixed when context is removed; missing evidence can make a question unanswerable.
QA uses exact source definitions and does not credit paraphrases.
KTRF adds production policy and execution authorization; these are full-system comparisons, not one-component effects.
Lexical paragraph retrieval is a deterministic control, not a trained RAG retrieval benchmark.
Full documents are never silently truncated; model-token capacity must be checked before inference.
Source retrieval only uses the target; knowledge retrieval uses the target and visible source, never hidden source or labels.
Model-family comparisons do not isolate parameter count. Preparation and retrieval costs are excluded from model-call latency.
declared_protocol.primary_score: Exact semantic match with fixed world gold; operational authorization reported separately.
declared_protocol.production_path: KTRF prepare_llm_context on visible source (or target alone); actual task policy and should_inject.
declared_protocol.retrieval: Top one paragraph by integer normalized-character/bigram Dice score, then adjacent paragraphs +/-1; position tie-break.

response_parser: JSON object, bare or one enclosing JSON code fence; no extra prose
